summary: Layer 1B expansion found one high-relevance underfollowed pure-play transformer/power-quality candidate, one adjacent custom electrical distribution equipment candidate, one second-order grid hardware candidate, and one large-cap reference anchor. The strongest direct node fit is Hammond Power Solutions via dry-type transformers, power-quality products, reactors, magnetics, North American manufacturing exposure, and explicit data-center product positioning. Powell Industries is not a transformer pure-play but maps to schedule-critical power distribution through medium-voltage switchgear, power control rooms, bus duct, motor control centers, specialty transformers, and data-center backlog commentary. Preformed Line Products is a second-order grid/transmission hardware supplier rather than a dry-type transformer maker, but it may benefit from upstream grid construction and utility capex tied to electrification and data-center interconnection. Eaton is included only as a reference leader for the broader power-management lane, not as the main underfollowed discovery target.
